name: GitHub Test Reporter
description: Build, publish and view test reports on job summaries and pull requests

report-path.description: Path or glob pattern of the CTRF JSON files.

template-path.description: Path to the Handlebars template for customizing markdown output.

title.description: Title to display in the GitHub Actions summary or pull request comment.

tests-changed-report.description: Include the tests changed report showing added and removed tests.

ai-summary-report.description: Include the AI summary report with structured analysis (summary, code issues, timeout issues, application issues, recommendations)

file-report.description: Include the file report showing tests grouped by file path.

insights-report.description: Include the insights report showing test metrics and statistics.

slowest-report.description: Include a report showing the top 10 slowest tests by average duration.

custom-report.description: Include a custom report using a Handlebars template. To group tests in the custom report, use the 'group-by' or 'always-group-by' input.

community-report.description: Include the community report. Also requires community-report-name.

summary.description: Post generated markdown to the GitHub Actions summary.

pull-request.description: Add a comment to the pull request with the generated report.

issue.description: Add a comment to the issue number with the generated report.

issue-repo.description: Repository containing the issue or pull request to comment on, in owner/repo format. Defaults to the repository running the workflow. Commenting on another repo

annotate.description: Add annotations to failed tests in the GitHub Actions UI.

status-check.description: Create a status check for the workflow.

community-report-name.description: Name of the community report to use.

on-fail-only.description: Add a pull request comment only if tests fail.

exit-on-no-files.description: Exit the workflow with a failure status if no test files are found.

exit-on-fail.description: Exit the workflow with a failure status if any tests fail.

exit-on-empty.description: Exit the workflow with a failure status if no tests are found.

use-suite-name.description: Prefix test names with the suite name for better grouping.

always-latest-comment.description: Create a new comment if the existing comment is not the latest in the thread.

comment-tag.description: Tag to match Pull Request comment

write-ctrf-to-file.description: Path to write the processed CTRF report for future processing.

upload-artifact.description: Upload the processed CTRF report for future processing

collapse-large-reports.description: Collapse large reports (test-table and test-list) by default.

artifact-name.description: Name of the artifact containing test reports.

previous-results-max.description: Maximum number of previous test results to display in the report. Includes test results from current run

flaky-rate-report-max.description: Maximum number of flaky tests to display in the flaky rate report.

fail-rate-report-max.description: Maximum number of failed tests to display in the fail rate report.

fetch-previous-results.description: Always fetch previous workflow runs when using custom templates.

max-workflow-runs-to-check.description: Maximum number of workflow runs to check for previous results.

max-previous-runs-to-fetch.description: Maximum number of previous runs to fetch and process for metrics and reports.

baseline.description: Baseline for metrics comparison. Number = previous n reports, string = reportId.

baseline-report-path.description: Path to a specific CTRF report to use as a baseline.

group-by.description: Specify grouping for applicable reports (e.g., suite or file path). Options: - 'suite': Group tests by their suite property. - 'filePath': Group tests by their

always-group-by.description: Force grouping by suite or file path for all reports, overriding default behavior

report-order.description:
Comma-separated list of report types to specify the order in which reports
 should be displayed in the summary.

ai.description: JSON configuration for AI-powered test analysis. Supports multiple AI providers including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Deepseek, Mistral, Perplexity, Azure Ope

integrations-config.description: JSON configuration for integrations with other developer tools
